name: Madi Pacific Beach
notes: 3 photos, all legible printed menus: 1.jpg is the breakfast/brunch board; 2.jpg and 3.jpg are the same lunch/build-your-own-bowl page (a clean digital screenshot and a physical photo of it) and were merged, not duplicated. Skipped mimosas, coffee, fresh juice, beverages, mocktails and cocktails sections (drinks only). Skipped add-on modifiers (add bacon, add avocado, sub grilled salmon, etc.) and the soup/salad/fries add-on. Most breakfast-menu items and the soup items have no printed price and are listed without one; two soups have a cup/bowl price pair instead of one price and are also left unpriced.
